units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python reads and writes PDF documents, converts them to other formats, and manipulates their content. It reads .pdf files and writes .pdf, .svg, .tiff, .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .tif, .htm, .html, .md, .json, .csv, .xfdf, and .zip outputs. It supports conversion to PDF/A, PDF/UA, and PDF/X standards, sanitizes documents, embeds fonts, and handles forms, annotations, bookmarks, and tables.

It creates new PDF documents, loads existing ones from file paths, raw bytes, or binary streams, and saves them back to files, bytes, or streams using the aspose_pdf.Document class and its from_bytes, from_stream, and load_from_stream methods.

It adds text, images, and vector graphics—including paths, rectangles, and circles defined by GraphicsPath—to pages, and places tables with headers, rows, and cell styling using the Page.add_text, Page.add_image, Page.draw_path, Page.draw_rectangle, and Page.add_table methods.

It extracts text from pages or regions, replaces or redacts text using regular expressions, automatically links recognized patterns, and highlights matched text with the Document.extract_text, Document.replace_text, Document.redact_text, Document.auto_link, and Document.highlight_text methods.

It extracts tables from pages, exports them as CSV files or lists, and exports block structures as JSON using the Document.extract_tables, ExtractedTable.save_csv, and Document.export_blocks_json methods.

It adds and manages tables of contents, bookmarks, and annotations by generating outlines from text or structure, importing and exporting bookmarks and annotations as JSON, extracting links, and validating link integrity using the Document.add_table_of_contents, Document.generate_outlines_from_text, Document.export_bookmarks_json, Document.import_bookmarks_json, Document.export_annotations_json, Document.import_annotations_json, Document.extract_links, and Document.validate_links methods.

It renders pages as images in PNG, TIFF, or JPEG format, exports pages or entire documents as SVG with selectable text, creates contact sheets of page thumbnails, and produces static, image-only PDF copies using the Document.save_page_as_image, Document.save_as_tiff, Document.save_as_svg, Document.render_contact_sheet, and Document.rasterized_copy methods.

It creates, fills, validates, flattens, and exports form fields such as text fields and checkboxes using the Form class and its add_text_field, add_checkbox, fill, flatten, validate, to_json_schema, and export_json_schema methods.

It secures documents with password encryption, signs them with digital signatures including PAdES-LTA support, embeds fonts, sanitizes content, and validates compliance with PDF/A, PDF/UA, and PDF/X standards using the Document.encrypt, Document.decrypt, Document.sign, Document.add_ltv, Document.add_document_timestamp, Document.embed_fonts, Document.sanitize, Document.validate_pdfa, Document.validate_pdfua, and Document.validate_pdfx methods.
Create a new PDF document with a single A4 page and add centered text to it, then save the file as hello.pdf.
Open an existing PDF, change its page size to A4 landscape, and apply a 28-point trim margin before saving the result as resized.pdf.

The Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python library exposes aspose_pdf.Document as the primary entry point for PDF lifecycle operations, and aspose_pdf.Page for per-page content editing. The low-code module aspose_pdf.lowcode provides focused tools for conversion, stamping, rotation, page removal, and form flattening.

The aspose_pdf.Document class manages the complete PDF lifecycle, supporting creation from bytes, streams, or file paths via from_bytes, from_stream, and load_from_stream, and saving with save; it exposes pages and page_count for navigation, info for metadata, and provides encrypt, decrypt, and sign for security operations.

The aspose_pdf.Page class provides methods to add text, images, tables, and graphics via add_text, add_image, add_table, draw_path, and draw_rectangle, and to inspect or export content through size, trim_box, annotations, extract_text, save_as_image, and save_as_svg.

The aspose_pdf.Form class handles interactive forms, allowing fields to be added with add_text_field and add_checkbox, filled and validated via fill and validate, flattened with flatten, exported to CSV or JSON schema with export_csv and export_json_schema, imported from JSON with import_json, reset to defaults with reset, and described via to_dict and to_json_schema.

The aspose_pdf.AnnotationCollection class manages annotations on a page, supporting addition of text, highlight, and file attachment annotations via add, add_text, add_highlight, and add_file_attachment, and cleanup or export through clear, delete, export_json, export_xfdf, import_json, to_list, and generate_appearances.

The aspose_pdf.PdfExtractor class extracts text, images, and file attachments from a PDF, binding to a source with bind_pdf, retrieving text page by page via extract_text, get_text, has_next_image, and get_next_image, extracting images and attachments with extract_image and extract_attachment, listing attachment names with get_attach_names, and cleaning up with close and dispose.

The aspose_pdf.lowcode.Converter class and its companion options classes ConvertOptions, DecryptOptions, EncryptOptions, FlattenOptions, ImageExtractorOptions, and ImagesToPdfOptions provide a low-code interface for converting documents, decrypting, encrypting, flattening forms, extracting images, and building PDFs from images via the Converter, Decryptor, Encryptor, FormFlattener, ImageExtractor, and ImagesToPdf plugins.

The aspose_pdf.lowcode.Stamper class, configured with StampOptions, places text, image, or page-number stamps over or under pages, while the low-code module also provides PdfAConverter with PdfAConvertOptions for PDF/A conversion, Rotator with RotateOptions for rotation, PageRemover with PageRemoveOptions for page removal, and FormFlattener for flattening forms.

The aspose_pdf.lowcode.ImagesToPdf class, configured with ImagesToPdfOptions, builds a PDF from one or more image files or streams, supporting size selection and fit modes to control how images fill the resulting pages.
The aspose_pdf.lowcode.PdfAConverter class, configured with PdfAConvertOptions, converts a PDF to PDF/A conformance, preserving structure and embedding fonts as required by the standard.
The aspose_pdf.lowcode.Rotator class, configured with RotateOptions, rotates pages in a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees, supporting selection of specific pages or ranges.
The aspose_pdf.lowcode.PageRemover class, configured with PageRemoveOptions, removes pages from a PDF by index, range, or selection criteria such as odd, even, or last.
The aspose_pdf.lowcode.FormFlattener class flattens interactive form fields and their annotations into the page content, removing interactivity and embedding field values permanently.

CaretAnnotation class represents a caret symbol used to indicate where text should be inserted, with a symbol property that accepts None or Paragraph values, and a frame property that stores its position.
DocumentFont class represents one font the document draws with, providing is_composite to indicate whether it is a composite font and pages to list the one-based page numbers that use it.
ExtractedTable class represents an inferred table with column_count and row_count properties, and methods to_csv and save_csv to export its data.

FontSubstitutionOptions class specifies font sources the renderer may substitute from, with directories and fonts properties for custom sources, use_system_fonts to include platform fonts, and a system method for platform font options.
FormValidationIssue class represents an issue found when validating a form field.
GraphicsPath class represents a path made of subpaths, with methods circle, close, curve_to, and current_point to build and inspect its geometry.
OptimizationOptions class holds options for PDF optimization, with a to_dict method to serialize its settings.
PDF3DLightingScheme enum lists the lighting schemes CUSTOM, DARK, GRAY, HEADLAMP, and WHITE for 3D annotations.
PDF3DRenderMode enum lists the render modes SOLID, TRANSPARENT, and WIREFRAME for 3D annotations.
Decoder class provides a decode method to decode CCITT-encoded data.
PdfArray class represents a PDF array object with an append method to add elements.
PdfBoolean class represents a PDF boolean object.
PdfDictionary class represents a PDF dictionary object with get and pop methods to access its entries.
PdfIndirectReference class represents a PDF indirect reference object.
PdfName class represents a PDF name object, and its constructor raises TypeError when given an invalid value.
PdfNumber class represents a PDF number object, and its constructor raises TypeError when given an invalid value.
PdfString class represents a PDF string object, and its constructor raises TypeError when given an invalid value.
Encoding class provides encoding support with methods encode and values LATIN1, UTF16, UTF8, and WIN_ANSI.
EncodingType enum lists the encoding types MAC_EXPERT, MAC_ROMAN, PDF_DOC, UNICODE, and WIN_ANSI.
FilterType enum lists the filter types CCITT_FAX_DECODE, DCT_DECODE, FLATE_DECODE, JBIG2_DECODE, JPX_DECODE, LZW_DECODE, and NONE.
PdfNull class represents a PDF null object.
PdfObjectID class represents a PDF object identifier.
PdfObjectRegistry class manages PDF object registration with get and register methods.
PdfTrailerable class provides a get_dictionary method to access the trailer dictionary.
Heading class represents one heading with its text, depth, and location.
Matrix class provides matrix operations with multiply and translate methods.
RevocationResult class represents the result of a revocation check.
RichRun class represents a run of rich text.
Revision class represents a signature revision.
StrokeRun class represents a run of stroke data.
LayerConfiguration class represents a named optional content configuration with creator, index, is_default, locks, name, and shows properties.
StructureTypeStandard enum lists the standard structure types DIV, DOCUMENT, P, PART, RB, RP, RT, SECT, SPAN, TABLE, TD, and TH.
PdfAConvertOptions class holds options for converting to PDF/A, including the level parameter.
PdfAConverter class converts inputs to PDF/A with a process method that collects unembedded fonts rather than raising an error.
PdfConsts class provides conversion methods decimal_to_octal and octal_to_decimal, both of which raise ValueError for invalid inputs.
Duplex enum lists the duplex modes DUPLEX, NONE, SIMPLEX, and TUMBLE.
PrintRange enum lists the print range options ALL_PAGES, PAGE_RANGE, SELECTION, and SOME_PAGES.
PrinterSettings class holds settings for printing.
CompromiseCheckResult class provides a compromised property to indicate whether a compromise was detected.
Margin class represents a margin for SVG rendering.
PageInfo class holds the bounding box and page index of an SVG page.
SvgLoadOptions class configures SVG loading with a conversion engine setting and a read-only page info property.
TaggedContext class provides the context for creating and managing tagged PDF content.
